title: Ordinary Soldier Dreams of the Past
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: John Celias, a common soldier in the war against the Demon King, watches the hero win and then dies to the enemy's remnants. He wakes as a baby in his hometown, which demons had destroyed in his first life, and uses his memories and combat experience to change his tragic fate. Based on a novel; seven volumes in Japan, with 19 chapters released in English per MangaUpdates.
life_message: A second chance should be spent protecting home and loved ones from a known tragedy.
